body:
CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: Living Map Phase 1 shipped (BACKLOG.md SECTION 377, docs/NORTHSTAR_LIVING_MAP.md): the entire map is now formalized as a hex grid via a new, standalone packages/livingmap package (docs/NORTHSTAR_LIVING_MAP.md's own 'new layer, not an extension of the arena map' framing -- packages/simulation's existing ArenaNode MOBA sim is untouched). New hex_grid.h/.c: axial-coordinate flat-top hex math (cube-coord distance/rounding, world<->hex conversion), a fixed hex-radius-12 map (469 cells). New living_map_events.h/.c: an always-on, append-only event-announcement ring buffer every town lifecycle transition writes into (founder: 'everything that happens in the game needs to announce events') -- the NORTHSTAR doc's own 'Mod event model, honestly' section names the real, current VS0 limit (no function pointers/closures) that rules out true dynamic multi-subscriber registration today, and what's real instead: the log plus the existing call-by-name mod convention. New town.h/.c: Town struct + registry; TownType names all 4 founder-specified types (Frontier Village, Walled Hamlet, Jungle Enclave, Blighted Settlement) but only Frontier Village has real behavior this pass, per founder's own 'start with the frontier village.' New PARENA/stdlib/ecowar/frontier_village_mod.prn (real I32 decision logic, card_effect_mod.prn's own 'real decision logic, not just a trigger' tier): spawn cadence that accelerates with population, a deterministic peasant->militia promotion rule, and a real, low conversion-resistance formula matching the founder's own 'spawns peasants -> militia, avoids conflict, converts easily' spec -- generated+committed frontier_village_mod.c via the real parena build CLI, same ARENA_API.md-documented process every other mod uses. 27 new tests across tests/test_hex_grid.c and tests/test_town_frontier_village.c, all passing headlessly via new scripts/test_livingmap.sh (wired into ci.yml as its own step) and a new packages/livingmap/BUILD.bazel :living_map cc_library (not locally verified against bazel itself -- bazel isn't installed in this sandbox, same real gap as every other manual-build-script-first change in this repo). Real, honest, not done: no wiring into apps/arena's live match loop, no rendering, no AI deciding where to found a town, Walled Hamlet/Jungle Enclave/Blighted Settlement/faction AI/tech tree/corruption mechanic/win condition all explicitly named as open design work in the NORTHSTAR doc, not guessed at. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
